label: Found in game files, unconfirmed in play. Talent-dependent abilities require the matching talent.

defensive.name: Last Stand
defensive.evidence: When activated, this ability temporarily grants you 30% of your maximum health for 20 sec. After the effect expires, the health is lost.

cooldowns.name: Death Wish
cooldowns.evidence: When activated, increases your Physical damage done by 20% and makes you immune to Fear effects, but increases all damage you take by 5%. Lasts 30 sec.

defensive.name: Holy Shield
defensive.evidence: Increases chance to block by 30% for 10 sec, and deals 75 Holy damage for each attack blocked while active.  Damage caused by Holy Shield causes 20% additional threat. Each block expends a charge. 4 charges.

cooldowns.name: Divine Favor
cooldowns.evidence: When activated, gives your next Flash of Light, Holy Light, or Holy Shock spell a 100% critical effect chance.

crowd-control.name: Intimidation
crowd-control.evidence: Command your pet to Stun the target for 3 sec on its next successful attack, which also gains 100% increased critical strike chance. Generates high threat.

cooldowns.name: Bestial Wrath
cooldowns.evidence: Send your pet into a rage causing 50% additional damage for 18 sec.  While enraged, the beast does not feel pity or remorse or fear and it cannot be stopped unless killed.

crowd-control.name: Riposte
crowd-control.evidence: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack.  This attack deals 150% weapon damage and disarms the target for [?].

cooldowns.name: Adrenaline Rush
cooldowns.evidence: Increases your Energy regeneration rate by 100% for 15 sec.

interrupt.name: Silence
interrupt.evidence: Silences the target, preventing them from casting spells for 5 sec and interrupting their spellcasts for 3 sec.

cooldowns.name: Power Infusion
cooldowns.evidence: Infuses the target with power, increasing their spell damage and healing done by 20% for 15 sec.

cooldowns.name: Nature's Swiftness
cooldowns.evidence: When activated, your next Nature spell with a casting time less than 10 sec. becomes an instant cast spell.

defensive.name: Ice Block
defensive.evidence: You become encased in a block of ice, protecting you from all physical attacks and spells for 10 sec, but during that time you cannot attack, move, or cast spells.

crowd-control.name: Blast Wave
crowd-control.evidence: A wave of flame radiates outward from the caster, damaging all enemies caught within the blast for 148 to 178 Fire damage, and Dazing them for 50% reduced movement speed for 6 sec.

cooldowns.name: Arcane Power
cooldowns.evidence: For the next 15 sec, your spells deal 30% more damage while costing 30% more mana to cast.

defensive.name: Soul Link
defensive.evidence: When active, 30% of all damage taken by the caster is taken by your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter Demon instead. In addition, both the Demon and the master will inflict 3% more damage. Lasts as long as the Demon is active.

crowd-control.name: Curse of Exhaustion
crowd-control.evidence: Reduces the target's movement speed by 30% for 12 sec.  Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

cooldowns.name: Fel Domination
cooldowns.evidence: Your next Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter Summon spell has its casting time reduced by 5.5 sec and its Mana cost reduced by 50%.
